INSERT INTO mentor_profiles (
  userId,
  university,
  major,
  grade,
  bio,
  hourlyRate,
  field,
  region,
  isActive,
  verificationStatus,
  isDeleted,
  averageRating,
  createdAt,
  updatedAt
) VALUES (
  @userId,
  'Seoul National University',
  'Computer Science',
  '4',
  'Experienced mentor in computer science and algorithm',
  '50000',
  'engineering',
  'seoul',
  true,
  'approved',
  false,
  4.8,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);
